<a id="identity-across-steps--跨步的同一"></a>
# Identity across steps

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`identity-across-steps` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](identity-across-steps.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Labels carry nothing: relations fix steps and conditions, and readings tracking a formation depend on who continues whom. One-way continuity leaves succession, two-way leaves it across dormancy; under a census more forces arising under every continuation without splits, across one step exactly then.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A web names its formations by a fixed index type, so which formation at one step is the same as which at the next is stipulated by the names. A re-identification relates two namings one to one at each step and keeps every step's levels, activity, dependences and drawing; a renaming is a re-identification that is the same at every step. (`Becoming.Web`, `Becoming.Reidentify`, `Becoming.Reidentify.rename`)
2. A renaming preserves the readings, defined from the relations, that follow a formation (checked for five): renewing or consuming in the run, the tenure of a dependence, undermining, forming and dissolving of dependences, arising and unceasing generation; labels carry nothing, while the pattern of names across steps carries identity. (`Becoming.Web.rename_renewingIn`, `Becoming.Web.rename_consumingIn`, `Becoming.Web.rename_tenure`, `Becoming.Web.rename_undermining`, `Becoming.Web.rename_unceasing`)
3. Every re-identification preserves each step's support, keeping and breaking, whether each condition is renewed, consumed or lost, whether activity occurs only where supported, and whether each event is within renewal and whether it breaks. (`Becoming.Web.reidentify_step`, `Becoming.Web.reidentify_renewed`, `Becoming.Web.reidentify_consumed`, `Becoming.Web.reidentify_lost`, `Becoming.Web.reidentify_dependent`, `Becoming.Web.reidentify_renewingAt`, `Becoming.Web.reidentify_breakingOn`)
4. Re-identifying a flow preserves what is taken and given at each step, the balance of depletion and replenishment, and the numbers of takers and renewers, so more without end. (`Becoming.Flow.reidentify_amounts`, `Becoming.Flow.reidentify_balances`, `Becoming.Flow.reidentify_counts`, `Becoming.Flow.reidentify_more`)
5. A census of the active formations and that only active formations take carry over too, so under them more without end makes generation unceasing under every re-identification, and the expansion meets all these premises. (`Becoming.Web.Census.reidentify`, `Becoming.Flow.Taking.reidentify`, `Becoming.Flow.More.unceasing_reidentified`, `Becoming.Expansion.unceasing_reidentified`)
6. Changing only who continues whom (exchanging names at every odd step), a renewing and a consuming formation become two consuming and none renewing; a drawer undermining at every step after the first becomes a web in which no event then undermines; a web in which no dependence forms and nothing arises becomes one where a formation transforms its dependence and formations arise at every odd step, generation unceasing. (`Becoming.Turnover.identified`, `Becoming.Turnover.reidentified`)
7. Arisings made by naming alone can meet every premise of Unceasing.activeRenewer_recurs: Depletes is not tied to the arising formation and does not screen out what naming makes. (`Becoming.TideFlip.naming_meets_premises`, `Becoming.Web.Unceasing.activeRenewer_recurs`, `Becoming.Web.Depletes`)
8. Keeping the names of formations active across a step, a re-identification makes no arising, hence no unceasing generation. (`Becoming.Reidentify.KeepsActive`, `Becoming.Web.arises_of_keepsActive`, `Becoming.Web.unceasing_of_keepsActive`)
9. Keeping the names of formations whose dependence continues across a step, it gives a formation one name over a tenure, keeps every dependence met while it held, and removes no undermining. (`Becoming.Reidentify.KeepsTenure`, `Becoming.Reidentify.steady`, `Becoming.Web.metAbove_of_keepsTenure`, `Becoming.Web.undermining_of_keepsTenure`)
10. Both conditions are read against the old naming: the new naming may join formations the old keeps apart, making a continuity, and never removes one.
11. Joining a formation that ends with one that begins at that step or later is succession: two members of a lineage active at alternate steps arise without end when named apart and are always active with nothing arising when named as one. (`Becoming.Lineage.arises`, `Becoming.Lineage.one`, `Becoming.Lineage.readings`)
12. A successor active and supported at the second step that needs more of the pool than it holds from the third makes drawing after a predecessor's loss undermine nothing when named apart, and undermine at every step from the third when it succeeds the predecessor. (`Becoming.Succession.succeeds`, `Becoming.Succession.inherited`, `Becoming.Succession.readings`)
13. In both witnesses the joined naming keeps the apart naming's continuity and the apart naming does not keep the joined naming's. (`Becoming.Lineage.one_way`, `Becoming.Succession.one_way`)
14. When the old naming also keeps the new naming's continuity (both ways), arising, unceasing generation and undermining are preserved exactly and succession at a single step is excluded. (`Becoming.Reidentify.back`, `Becoming.Web.arises_of_back_keepsActive`, `Becoming.Web.arises_iff_of_keepsActive_both`, `Becoming.Web.unceasing_iff_of_keepsActive_both`, `Becoming.Web.metAbove_of_back_keepsTenure`, `Becoming.Web.undermining_of_back_keepsTenure`, `Becoming.Web.undermining_iff_of_keepsTenure_both`, `Becoming.Web.no_join`)
15. Joining across a dormant step, at which neither formation is active or depends on anything, keeps continuity both ways and still changes which formation renews and which consumes. (`Becoming.Dormancy.join`, `Becoming.Dormancy.keeps_both`, `Becoming.Dormancy.classes`)
16. Continuation relations read splits and merges: under a census, present without repetition and Taking, under every continuation in which no formation continues as two, more without end makes formations arise at arbitrarily late steps; every re-identification is such a continuation, and so is one with merges. (`Becoming.Web.Continues`, `Becoming.Web.NoSplit`, `Becoming.Flow.More.unceasingFrom`, `Becoming.Web.continuation_reidentify`, `Becoming.Merge.merging`)
17. On the expansion, whose formations never end, the merge comes with a persisting formation re-read as arising at every step, so the conclusion holds there without more, while where the merged formation ends, what arises under a merge is exactly what is new. (`Becoming.Merge.idle`, `Becoming.Confluence.confluence`)
18. The decidability it asks follows from the census and a decidable continuation; without a census, no split is not enough. (`Becoming.Web.Census.decideContinues`, `Becoming.Dormant.no_split_without_arising`)
19. No split is sufficient, not necessary: a single split need not stop arising; reading new formations as budding from one already there, the same growth forces no arising after the first step. (`Becoming.Identity.Fork.split_unceasing`, `Becoming.Budding.growth_without_arising`)
20. Across one step the condition is exact: for any lists before and after the step, the one after without repetition, more always leaves some formation after the step continuing none before it exactly when no formation continues as two, the necessary direction using decidable equality. (`Becoming.forces_iff_noSplit`)
21. Arising is forced under every continuation without splits exactly when more formations are listed after the step than before: with no more, pairing in order gives a continuation without splits continuing every formation after the step. (`Becoming.forced_iff_more`, `Becoming.paired`, `Becoming.paired_noSplit`, `Becoming.paired_covers`)
22. So across one step no split is the necessary and sufficient condition on the continuation, and more on the counts; over a run a single split acts only at its step. (`Becoming.Identity.Fork.forks`)
23. Naming the lineage itself beside its members, the lineage is active at every step while its members arise without end; a web has no part–whole relation. (`Becoming.Layered.both`)
24. For any holding predicate h, keeping its names fixes one name over a held stretch and the whole-run renewing and consuming classes of a formation holding at every step. (`Becoming.Web.Holds`, `Becoming.Web.steady_held`, `Becoming.Web.renewingIn_held`, `Becoming.Web.consumingIn_held`)
25. Waking from holding is not holding-arising. Hibernation makes this stronger than two-way activity and tenure continuity; dormancy permits a join where nothing holds, and dependence and reserve give Seed different endings. (`Becoming.Web.waking_not_arising`, `Becoming.Hibernation.readings`, `Becoming.Dormancy.held_both`, `Becoming.Seed.held_readings`)
26. Web.persisting_census instantiates the original census laws with both ends read through holding and their separate hypotheses retained; Sleeper refutes mixing the readings. (`Becoming.Web.persisting_census`, `Becoming.Sleeper.held_readings`)
27. World.balanced_reidentify_iff, without an additional hypothesis, characterizes balanced re-identifications as one-to-one continuations within World.Conserves. In a balanced world conservation is equality of standing after the step, linked to likeness through exchange_alike_iff, and keeping and breaking are invariant. (`Becoming.World.balanced_reidentify_iff`, `Becoming.World.Conserves`, `Becoming.World.conserves_iff`, `Becoming.exchange_alike_iff`, `Becoming.World.kept_broken_reidentify`)
28. With decidable equality of relata, World.fixed_iff, World.arises_fixed_iff and World.ceases_fixed_iff characterize identity, arising and ceasing fixed by every balance-preserving naming; where standing after every step distinguishes all relata, such namings are fixed renamings and classes are fixed. (`Becoming.World.fixed_iff`, `Becoming.World.arises_fixed_iff`, `Becoming.World.ceases_fixed_iff`, `Becoming.World.classes_fixed`)
29. Shuttle instantiates this; Lineage and Hibernation permit two namings preserving per-step relations and balance but changing arisings or classes. (`Becoming.Shuttle.conserved`, `Becoming.Lineage.world_readings`, `Becoming.Hibernation.world_readings`)
30. More forcing arising under re-identification holds of every world in a local form with no census: only lists covering the active formations at arbitrarily late steps and, from some step on, each formation taking part listed once and whatever takes active; Flow.More.unceasing_reidentified is its corollary. (`Becoming.Flow.More.unceasing_reidentified_covering`)
31. Over a run, under a census at every step, the condition is exact on the counts: every continuation without a split leaves, at arbitrarily late steps, some formation after a step continuing none before it exactly when more are active after a step than before at arbitrarily late steps; at steps with no more, pairing the lists in order continues every formation after the step with no split. A continuation without a split from some step on suffices. (`Becoming.ListedWebs.forcedAlong_iff_more`, `Becoming.ListedWebs.forcedAlong_of_eventually_noSplit`)
32. Identity where standings coincide: in a balanced world with equality of relata decided, where d stands after a step as c does, exchanging them after the step keeps the balance and continues c as d; every record at each step is kept by any re-identification, so no record of the world decides between the two, and with fixed_iff identity across a step is fixed exactly where no other relatum stands alike after it. (`Becoming.World.continues_as_alike`, `Becoming.World.fixed_iff`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- A re-identification is one to one at each step. Splits and merges, in which one formation continues as several or several as one, are not re-identifications: they change the continuation relation, not the number of formations at any step; continuation relations (Continues) represent them.
- Continuity is read as: formations active across a step keep their names (KeepsActive), and formations whose dependence on a condition continues across a step keep their names (KeepsTenure). Read against the old naming, it is one-way; read also against the new naming (Reidentify.back), it is two-way. Both are the author's readings, not a definition of identity.
- Re-identifying a flow rewrites present one to one at each step; that present lists each formation taking part once per step remains a correspondence premise.
- More.unceasing_reidentified uses the census, present without repetition and Taking of more-needs-renewers, and decidable activity (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom).
- Flow.More.unceasingFrom also uses that no formation continues as two under the continuation (NoSplit), and that whether a formation continues an active one is decidable (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom; under a census it follows from a decidable continuation, Census.decideContinues).
- P87 supplies a holding predicate h; activity and dependence contained in it separately yield the original continuity conditions. Whole-run class equivalence additionally requires that formation to hold at every step.
- The P87 holding census requires a census and decisions of held activity, Continues, Continued and continuation R. Ceasing recurring implies arising recurring under no split; the converse uses no merge and an eventual fixed census bound. Both ends use holding.
- The conservation characterization of balanced re-identifications adds no hypothesis; equivalence to equal post-step standing assumes the original world balanced. fixed_iff, arises_fixed_iff and ceases_fixed_iff also use decidable equality of relata. classes_fixed requires post-step standing to distinguish every relatum at every step, with both original and re-identified worlds balanced.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Re-identification covers only one-to-one correspondence; splits and merges are continuation relations, under which the arising forced by more is stated, and the renewing and consuming classes are stated in classes-along-a-continuation, but not tenure or undermining.
- Over a run no split is sufficient for more to force arising, not necessary: a fixed continuation splitting at some steps can still force it. The exact condition over a run is stated on the counts, quantifying over every continuation without a split (law 31); for one fixed continuation, that splits occur at only finitely many steps is sufficient and not shown necessary. Witness: `Becoming.Identity.Fork.split_unceasing`.
- The arising in Merge is a persisting formation re-read, and a witness under a merge in which more does the work is not given. Witness: `Becoming.Merge.idle`.
- Continuity is one reading of identity, not its definition; one-way and two-way continuity are two readings, and the original two-way continuity does not constrain succession across dormancy. Witness: `Becoming.Dormancy.keeps_both`.
- Holding continuity fixes the class of a formation holding throughout, but a step with no holding still permits a join; identity fixed by conservation under balanced namings leaves exactly the choice where standings coincide, which no record of the world decides (law 32).
- More.unceasing_reidentified and More.unceasingFrom hold only under a census, present without repetition and Taking, do not say which formation arises, and under budding force only that the active formations have no bound.
- Succession, a tenure's continuing through it and the level of 生生不息 are readings, not given by this result.
- The part–whole relation is stated in whole-persists-through-generation through activity only, without the whole's dependence or undermining; the witnesses are minimal.
- **Counterexample:** Turnover: changing only who continues whom changes formation classes, undermining, transformation and arising, and unceasing generation is made by re-identification alone; in Turnover those arisings lower no condition and Depletes fails. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identity.lean)
- **Counterexample:** TideFlip: the tide and the moon with nothing arising, their names exchanged at every odd step; arisings made by naming alone meet every premise of Unceasing.activeRenewer_recurs, so Depletes does not screen out what naming makes (independent review I8). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identity.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Lineage and Succession: re-identifications keeping one-way continuity can still hide arising and add undermining, with a successor active and supported at its first active step; both are succession, and the joined naming keeps continuity only one way (Lineage.one_way, Succession.one_way, independent review I5, I11). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identity.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Dormancy: joining across a dormant step keeps continuity both ways and still changes a formation's class: named apart, the early formation renews and the late one consumes; joined, the formation named early consumes and does not renew (independent review I6). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identity.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Budding: in the cycle the census, present without repetition, Taking and more without end all hold; reading new formations as budding from formation 0 (one formation continuing as many), nothing arises after the first step: some splits defeat “more forces arising” (independent review I9); no split is sufficient, and a single split need not defeat it (Fork, independent review J9). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identity.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Layered: naming the lineage itself beside its members, the lineage is active at every step while its members arise without end; the part–whole relation between them is not in Identity's web (independent review I10); in Becoming.Wholes the lineage is the whole of its members (Layered.composed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identity.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Independent review: every declaration of this record then is accepted with empty axiom reports; one-way continuity, succession across dormancy, “names carry nothing”, naming-made arisings meeting the premises of Unceasing.activeRenewer_recurs, “every reading of identity” and the description of splits, the lineage either/or, the successor that never lives, and identity-dependent readings unmarked in their records (corrected in the integration note). [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/BECOMING-P11B-P12-REVIEW.md)
- **Counterexample:** No split is not necessary (Identity.Fork.split_unceasing): in the cycle formation 0 continues as two at step one, NoSplit fails, and formations still arise at arbitrarily late steps (independent review J9). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identity.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Under a continuation with merges the theorem's premises hold (Merge.merging): the expansion's ith renewer and grower both continue as the ith renewer, there is no split, and decidability comes from the census (Census.decideContinues); but no formation continues as a grower, so a grower that stays active is re-read as arising at every step and the conclusion holds without more (Merge.idle; K7 of the independent review corrected the earlier “applies non-vacuously”). Where the merged formation ends, what arises under the merge is exactly the new formation of each step (Confluence.confluence). A census witness under a merge in which more does the work is not given. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identity.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Without a census, no split is not enough (Dormant.no_split_without_arising): in Dormant, with each formation continuing only itself, there is no split, Taking, present without repetition and more without end hold, and nothing arises (independent review J10). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identity.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Holding continuity: Hibernation separates old and holding continuity; Dormancy permits a join with no holding; two Seed predicates give different endings; Sleeper refutes a mixed census; Lineage.world_readings and Hibernation.world_readings preserve balance under namings with different arisings or classes. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Persistence.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The open programme and the next step of becoming-dependence-dynamics list the individuation of formations: the distinction between ending and transformation depends on a supplied identity. This result states in which readings that supplied identity matters: readings of each step and each condition do not depend on it, readings that follow a formation do; continuity read one way rules out making arising and removing undermining, and succession remains a reading; read both ways it preserves arising and undermining exactly, and still does not constrain a formation's class over the run. The pattern of names across steps carries identity: this is a correspondence premise the representation supplies, and Turnover shows it is substantive; the check of the method requirement that separate naming must not smuggle in independent entities is this disclosure, not invariance under renaming, since a renaming keeps the pattern by construction. A lineage and its members are two levels of one unfolding: the lineage as a whole continues precisely as its members arise without end (Layered); a single level of naming represents only one of them, and the part–whole relation is what this representation omits; whole-persists-through-generation states that relation, and where members do not last the lineage's persistence entails that its members arise without end. On Ren's delegation 生生不息 is read at the level of the whole, lineages and members being levels within it at which continuation is read: 不息 as arising that recurs through renewal, and 生生不息 as 生生 going on with more still able to form, so return falls short (DELEGATED-CHOICES D5, revised and taken by Ren on 18 October 2026); reading it only as the lineage's continuation is in tension with the “不断创造” of Ren's words (the author's note); where members do not last, the entailment above removes that tension. By the same decision, a successor inherits a predecessor's loss exactly where the succession keeps the tenure: later drawing below it undermines on the working reading (Succession.readings), and where the dependence lapses the reading starts afresh (Gap.lapse_starts_afresh). P87 supplies h and offers activity-or-dependence as Holds and conservation of standing as a continuation reading; these do not exhaust actual material, informational or organizational continuity.

  - Output: exchangeFrame, Alike and exchange_alike_iff.
  - Input: World.balanced_reidentify_iff_alike.
  - Preserved conditions: The original world balances; re-identification is one to one at each step. [Labelled.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Labelled.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [becoming-stepwise-reading](becoming-stepwise-reading.md). The working reading “active and not undermining” depends on identity across steps through tenure; whether succession continues a tenure is a choice within that reading.
- related, not a proved adapter: [theory-of-becoming-foundation](theory-of-becoming-foundation.md). Relational unity and differentiation: determinations of each step and each condition are fixed by relations; identity across steps is supplied by the representation, continuity read one way constrains it up to succession, and read both ways up to succession across dormancy; the part–whole relation is not represented. The whole deduction remains open.
- related, not a proved adapter: [whole-persists-through-generation](whole-persists-through-generation.md). States the part–whole relation this result omits: a whole is active exactly while some part is, and where parts are brief, or end with finitely many active at once, a whole persists through the generation of its parts.
- related, not a proved adapter: [census-balance-under-continuation](census-balance-under-continuation.md). The census balance under a continuation: without splits ceasing recurring needs arising recurring, without merges under a bounded count conversely; budding and joining each defeat one half (Tandem).

<a id="history--沿革"></a>
### History

- 2026-10-09: added as P12 of the unification plan, taking up “the individuation of formations” from the open programme and the next step of becoming-dependence-dynamics; following Ren's “move on to pursue the theory of becoming, and prove the necessary proofs”.
- 2026-10-09: P12b corrected this record following the fifth independent review (BECOMING-P11B-P12-REVIEW.md): “names carry nothing” became “labels carry nothing”, with the pattern of names across steps carrying identity; continuity was split into one-way and two-way readings, with the two-way theorems, Lineage.one_way, Succession.one_way, Dormancy, TideFlip, Garden.unceasing_reidentified and Layered added; Succession's heir now lives and is supported; splits and merges are described as changes of the continuation relation, with continuation relations, NoSplit, More.unceasingFrom, continuation_reidentify and Budding added; the lineage AI argument became two levels with the part–whole relation omitted. The name-exchanging witnesses share Reidentify.exchanging. The consolidated checker was rerun (20261009T060305.410034Z). Title, claim, hypotheses, correspondence, counterexamples, limitations and next step were rewritten accordingly.
- 2026-10-09: after P16 added whole-persists-through-generation, the limitations, next step, correspondence, the Layered counterexample and related results point to it; the claim and proofs are unchanged.
- 2026-10-09: P16b integrates the sixth independent review (J9, J10): no split is sufficient, not necessary (Fork); the title and claim restore the census, present without repetition and Taking (Dormant.no_split_without_arising); a witness with merges (Merge), no join at a single step (no_join) and decidability from the census (Census.decideContinues) are added; list lemmas move to Becoming.Population; the existing theorems and proofs are unchanged.
- 2026-10-09: P16c integrates the seventh independent review (K7): the unceasing arising under Merge does not use more (Merge.idle), and Confluence is added as a witness in which the merged formation ends; the gloss on Merge is corrected; the existing theorems and proofs are unchanged.
- 2026-10-09 P18b: the related note to whole-persists-through-generation corrected following the eighth independent review's L2, with the premises stated. The claim is unchanged.
- 2026-10-10 P34b: following the thirteenth independent review's U8, the English claim says more formations are listed after the step than before (it said more stand, and standing is a term of the theory, a positive level); the Chinese already said so. The content of the claim is unchanged.
- 2026-10-11 P60: local laws for every world added, Flow.More.unceasing_reidentified_covering (group D of the zero-premise plan, section 1.3), the local condition inside the law; Flow.More.unceasing_reidentified re-proved in place as their corollaries, names and statements unchanged. The claim is unchanged. The author's note is in section 75 of the integration note.
- 2026-10-13 P87: extends this record on dormancy and relational identity, preserving prior results and counterexamples; holding continuity, balanced naming and their boundaries are in integration note §108.
- 2026-10-13 takeover reconciliation: current consolidated receipt 20261013T094743.528770Z contains 22 inherited modules; the carried-over count of 15 in the current validation summary is corrected to 22. Historical receipts and their original counts remain unchanged, as do the claim, premises and proofs.
- 14 October 2026, general laws and renames (plan section 10, study section 112): Lean sources: Identity, Persistence, Unfolding only renamed (with the matching docstrings); bindings move to the new receipts (see validation scope); the study only adds section 112 (general laws and renames) and its paragraph in the English summary; the unification plan only adds the 14 October 2026 rename table after the P36 table in section 10. This record's claim, premises and status are unchanged; no reproof is credited.
- 14 October 2026 readability migration to schema 2 (M3): the long title became a short name with the statement first; the claim was split into 30 laws; limitations, per-round receipts and process notes went to does-not-show items, standard boundaries, the evidence paragraph and history. No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. The holding and conservation laws, added as P87, keep their label here only; the local restatement appended to the next step became law 30. In the counterexamples the review summary names this record's declarations and the premises of Unceasing.regeneration_recurs in place of the round labels P12 and P10 and the section of its corrections, and the persistence witnesses are introduced as holding continuity in place of the label P87. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [identity-across-steps.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/identity-across-steps.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.
